# Kavach

> A compiled language that is easy to write, fast to run and safe for AI agents. Files end in `.kav`. This guide is the whole language in brief; the full spec is docs/spec/. Kept under 4,000 tokens and checked by tests (tools/ai/tests/llms.rs).

## Rules that matter most
- No semicolons: a line ends a statement. A line ending in an operator, `,` `(` `[` `{` continues; so does a next line starting with `.`.
- `const` can't change, `let` can. Parameters can't be reassigned.
- Values, not references: assigning or passing copies. Only `Shared<T>` is shared.
- No null: `T?` holds a value or `none`.
- No exceptions: a function that can fail says `! ErrorType`; callers must `try`, `catch` or `match`.
- Every function that returns a value writes `-> Type`. A call's result must be used or discarded with `const _ =`.
- Names: `snake_case` values and functions, `PascalCase` types, variants, capabilities, agents.
- Files stay under 500 lines.

## Basics
```kavach
const name = "Asha"                 // String
let count = 0
count += 1
const price: Decimal = 499.00       // exact; literals take their type from context
const big = 1_000_000 + 0xff + 0b1010
print("Hi {name}, {count + 1}")   // {expr} interpolation; \{ for a literal brace
const raw = r"C:\path"
const ok = not false and (1 < 2 or false)
const label = user?.name ?? "guest" // ?. reads through optionals, ?? gives a default
```
Integer overflow and division by zero panic. `Int / Int` is an `Int`. Convert explicitly: `Float(n)`, `Int.parse(text)` (can fail).

## Types
```kavach
type Status = Pending | Paid | Refunded
type Shape = Circle(radius: Float) | Rect(width: Float, height: Float)

type Order {
    id: Int
    amount: Decimal
    status: Status = Pending
    secret card: String           // can't reach print, logs or AI prompts

    invariant amount >= 0

    fn is_paid(self) -> Bool { self.status == Paid }
}

interface Describe {
    fn describe(self) -> String
}

extend Order: Describe {
    fn describe(self) -> String { "Order {self.id}" }
}
```
Create records with named arguments: `Order(id: 1, amount: 10, card: "x")`. Copy with changes: `order with { status: Paid }`. Collections: `[Int]`, `[String: Int]` (insertion-ordered), `Set<T>`, tuples `(Int, String)`. Generics: `fn first<T>(items: [T]) -> T?`.

## Functions
```kavach
pub fn transfer(from: Account, amount: Decimal, note: String = "") -> Account ! BankError
    uses Payments
    require amount > 0
    ensure result.balance == from.balance - amount
    example transfer(Account(balance: 10), 50) fails Insufficient(needed: 40)
{
    if amount > from.balance {
        fail Insufficient(needed: amount - from.balance)
    }
    from with { balance: from.balance - amount }
}
```
Clause order is fixed: `->`, `!`, `uses`, `require`, `ensure`, `example`. The last expression is the result. Lambdas: `x => x * 2`, `(a, b) => a + b`; dot shorthand in arguments: `orders.filter(.status == Paid).sum(.amount)`.

## Control flow
```kavach
const grade = if score >= 90 { "A" } else { "B" }
if let user = find(7) {
    print(user.name)
}
const text = match shape {
    Circle(radius) => "circle {radius}"
    Rect(width, height) if width == height => "square"
    Rect(width: w, height: _) => "rect {w}"
}
for i in 0..10 {
    print(i)
}
for (name, age) in ages {
    print(name)
}
while attempts < 3 {
    attempts += 1
}
```
`match` must cover every case. Conditions must be `Bool`. No labeled `break`.

## Errors
```kavach
const age = parse_age(input) catch 0
const next = parse_age(input) catch e => {
    print("bad: {e}")
    0
}
const n = try parse_age(input) context "reading the age"
match parse_age(input) {
    ok(age) => print(age)
    err(TooLarge(value)) => print(value)
    err(_) => print("bad")
}
```
`fn main() ! Error` accepts any error; `main` failing exits with code 1, a panic with 101.

## Capabilities and agents
```kavach
capability Payments {
    fn refund(order_id: Int, amount: Decimal) -> Receipt ! PaymentError
}

agent RefundBot {
    can Ai, Payments.refund
    limit Payments.refund {
        amount <= 10_000
        sum(amount) <= 50_000 per day
    }
    approve Payments.refund when amount > 5_000 by "finance"

    on request(order: Order) ! Error {
        const decision = try ask<RefundDecision>("Refund order {order.id}?")
        if decision.approve {
            const receipt = try Payments.refund(order.id, order.amount)
        }
    }
}
```
A function without `uses` is pure. Built-in capabilities: `Console`, `Fs`, `Net`, `Env`, `Clock`, `Random`, `Ai`, `Foreign`. `ask<T>` returns a checked `T`.

## Memory
Automatic, no garbage collector. `Shared(0)` for shared state, `arena { … }` for bulk allocation (values can't escape), `unsafe { … }` only when `kavach.toml` sets `unsafe = true`.

## Standard library (spec 14)
`use std.fs` then `fs.read_text(path)`, `fs.write_text(path, text)` (atomic); also `std.time` (`for tick in time.every_ms(500)`), `std.math`, `std.io`, `std.cli` (`cli.parse<Args>()` reads options into a record), `std.regex` (`regex.new(r"\d+")`, linear time; `regex.advanced` for lookaround). Calling them needs the capability (`uses Fs`). Lists: `sort`, `sort_by`, `join`, `find`, `count`, `take`, `skip`; text: `replace`, `lines`, `slice`; `Set.of(1, 2)`.

## Testing: write contracts, not test files
`kavach test` generates inputs from types and `require`, checks `ensure` and invariants, fakes capabilities, and runs every `example`. Write a `test "name" { … }` block only for multi-step stories.

## Tools: ask the compiler instead of reading files
```
kavach run file.kav            # run (add --native for machine code)
kavach test file.kav           # examples and tests
kavach check --format json file.kav
kavach outline file.kav        # declarations without bodies
kavach query callers|uses|fails|type|find NAME file.kav
kavach context NAME file.kav --budget 2000
```
